A '''skirmish''' against the forces of [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] took place in an unremarkable [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Choices" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="TERCD" /> Against Esva's six [[Starship/Legends|starships]] fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial-II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] and the warlord's [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]''. Esva, posing as [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member "[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo," [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] both sides of the skirmish, which resulted in four of [[Gender/Legends|his]] ships' destruction and the escape of two and slight damage to the ''Chiamera''.<ref name="Choices" />
